question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the occasions between the mid-1960s and the early 1970s when a railcar type began operating on the train.
why_needs_multiple: Chỉ hai mốc bắt đầu trong khoảng (1966, 1969) nên dùng list, không dùng summary; khoảng bắt đầu từ giữa thập niên 1960 để tránh mốc undated MÁVAG (1960–1962).
criterion: a railcar type begins operating on the train (start of service only)

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the occasions between the mid-1960s and the late 1970s when a railcar or DMU type stopped running on the train, either because its service ended or because it was replaced.
why_needs_multiple: Ba lần loại đầu máy/toa bị dừng hoặc thay thế (1964, 1972, 1979) cùng loại; tách khỏi câu bắt đầu để không đếm cặp bắt đầu–kết thúc của cùng một giai đoạn.
criterion: a railcar or DMU type stops operating on the train (its service ended or it was replaced)

question: Counted by calendar year, how many years passed from Wien Mitte station becoming the train's terminus until the trains first passing through Berlin on the new North–South mainline?
why_needs_multiple: Hai mốc đích danh ở hai thời điểm (1975, 2006); khoảng cách không suy ra từ một mốc.
criterion: time gap between Wien Mitte becoming the terminus and trains passing through Berlin via the new North–South mainline
